title: The app's permanent ID: your messes moved over
thisBuild: This is the new app, app.shotgunstudio.messmachine, the ID it will have on Google Play and the App Store. It installed next to the old one.
On its first launch it copied your messes, Workbench sounds, packs and settings from the old app. A message said how many files came across.
Updates from here on come to this app.
watch: Open Messes: are all your messes there? Open one with your own recordings and play it.
Check Settings: your skin, look and view size should match the old app.
limits: Once everything is here, uninstall the old Mess Machine (the one with the same icon that no longer updates).
If the message said nothing moved, update the old app once, then open this one again.
